Sometime after the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]], [[Lieutenant]] [[Galek]] deployed her [[cadet]]s against a flight of drones, in which all of the target [[X-wing starfighter]]s were destroyed. ==Characteristics== X-wing drones were [[pilot]]less [[Starship|spacecraft]] built as pared-down replicas of [[X-wing starfighter]]s. Featuring a [[Color|red]]-and-gray–colored [[hull]], the [[drone]]s were equipped with four [[laser cannon]]s that fired red [[laser]]s. Each of these [[cannon]]s were mounted at the end of each wider [[S-foils|S-foil]] wing, which were also attached to four smaller wings in a similar fashion to the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter]]s{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-7-fun-facts-from-live-fire-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Live Fire" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2019-10-21}} that inspired the [[T-series X-wing line|X-wing line]].''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' ==Role== {{Quote|Pilots, this will be a live-fire exercise. There are no stun blasts in battle.|Lieutenant Galek|}} The drones were used as target practice for [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|TIE pilots]] of the [[First Order]]. ==History== {{Quote|But I downed the most drones and helped a fellow pilot.''"
"''No, you risked the entire mission by breaking off the attack. Your job was to destroy the enemy, ''[…]''|Cadet [[Tamara Ryvora]] and Lieutenant Galek|}} [[File:DroneXwing-LiveFire.png|thumb|right|180px|Lieutenant Galek of the First Order deployed several drones for a training exercise.]] Not long after the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]], [[Lieutenant]] [[Galek]], a First Order [[flight instructor]], deployed three X-wing drones for a live-fire training exercise for her pilot [[cadet]]s around the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'', all of which would be destroyed by the cadets’ [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE/fo fighters]] during the event. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|The First Order X-wing drones are a new design for ''Star Wars'', made for this episode. They're pared-down replicas that the First Order TIE pilots use for practice.|[[Amy Beth Christenson]]|}} X-wing drones were created and designed for "[[Live Fire]]," the third episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated series that first aired on [[October 20]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes/live-fire|text="Live Fire"|quote=Air Date: 10/20/2019}} The drones were later identified by name in the episode's accompanying [[StarWars.com]] episode guide,{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/live-fire-episode-guide|text="Live Fire" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} as well as in the ''[[Bucket's List]]'' and "Bucket's List Extra" behind-the-scenes looks for "Live Fire."{{BucketsList|uty_NdX86t8|"Live Fire"|date=2019-10-21}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Live Fire}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/live-fire-episode-guide|text="Live Fire" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} {{1stID|X-wing drone|{{SWKidsYouTube|uty_NdX86t8|Bucket's List: "Live Fire" -
